jordan: Heads-up: starting migration window in 10m for tenant_metadata add-col + backfill. Deploybot kicked off canary job.
deploybot: [automated] canary-job-1725009999 started on pool-gpu-3. Logs: https://ci.internal/logs/1725009999 :robot_face:
neha: Copying notes here — backfill will touch ~22M rows, we plan small-batch workers (concurrency=4) and selective index pause. If we see >150ms p99 DB latency we pause and revert workers.
sam: @neha what’s the eviction policy for KV cache during backfill? we had an OOM once last year when backfill surged.
neha: KV eviction is set to lru-approx, memory target 70%. Backfill will do exponential backoff on retries. If eviction spikes we’ll drop concurrency to 1.
maria: Also adding release note: "tenant_metadata: added is_verified boolean, safe default false; backfill in window; rollback criteria: >3% error rate or >2x baseline latency for 5m" — agree?
jordan: agree. rolling canary then wave. Pin API connector version to v2.4.1 for this deploy to avoid schema mismatch.
deploybot: [automated] canary progress: 6/10 shards processed, avg row rate 320r/s, DB p95 78ms, p99 142ms.
sam: p99 creeping up. @neha start throttling to 200r/s and drop concurrency to 2.
neha: throttled. running: set CONCURRENCY=2 BATCH_SIZE=500 RATE_LIMIT=200
jordan: posting rollback escape hatch now: if error_count > 600 or background_job_fails for 3 consecutive shards -> abort and trigger rollback job 1725009999-rollback
maria: added to release notes: rollback trigger thresholds and contact list.
sam: deploybot, can you surface a simple snapshot of current DB replica lag and rowcounts every minute to the thread?
deploybot: [automated] snapshot @1725010000: replica_lag=2s, processed_rows=8,600,000, errors=2 :white_check_mark:
neha: seeing small spike at 1725010300, p99=210ms. Will pause new shard pickup for 5m and let existing workers drain.
jordan: good. Notify if errors > 10 in drain window.
deploybot: [automated] worker-handoff: paused new shard assignment. queue_length=3
maria: quick note for docs/console: annotate model/api aware flagging to avoid clients hitting the new column until rollouts complete.
sam: after drain, if metrics stable for 10m we resume. If not, we run rollback. TL;DR: canary paused, monitoring, thresholds set. :eyes:
neha: manual check — verified no long locks in pg_stat_activity, only short writes. continuing monitor.
jordan: thanks team. I'll update the release ticket and slide the dedicated capacity alert to low. If we abort, we'll run rollback steps: 1) cancel ongoing backfill workers 2) revert migration using shadow swap (fast path) 3) unpin api version back to v2.4.0 and redeploy.
maria: adding postmortem template to ticket in case we hit abort. Keep this thread for live updates.
deploybot: [automated] final snapshot @1725011200: replica_lag=1s, processed_rows=11,900,000, errors=5, p99=158ms. Canaries paused. Waiting for resume_command.
